// SYNTHETIC, format-faithful subset of CS2's scripts/items/items_game.txt, written for the
// WeaponSkins econ unit tests. It is NOT an extract of the live game file and must never be used
// as a source of game facts: the def_index/name pairs and models below are fixture data chosen to
// exercise the parser (the task owner asked for 23 = weapon_mp5sd specifically; the real mapping
// always comes from the game's own items_game.txt at runtime through s2sdk::ReadFileVPK).
//
// Structure mirrors the real file: "prefabs" with chained `prefab` references, "items" keyed by
// def_index, several repeated blocks ("paint_kits" twice, "sticker_kits" twice), a pre-KV1-style
// prefab cycle (loop_a <-> loop_b), used_by_classes on both items and prefabs, agents under the
// `customplayertradable` prefab, and loot_lists / client_loot_lists with a reference chain and a
// cycle.
